text.p: First Enterprise Financial Group Inc said Friday it issued $44.1 million 6.45 percent fixed rate automobile loan notes, Series 1997-A, through a wholly owned subsidiary under a $200 million three-year securitization facility.
The notes have an estimated average life of about 1.4 years and were priced 69 basis points over the comparable treasury rate. First Enterprise will act as servicer for the portfolio.
Banc One Capital Corp is the placement agent for this private offering.
Proceeds from the offering were used to pay down the First Enterprise senior credit facility bank line.
